purpose: Precompute fresh, structured industry prosperity evidence before the formal A-share low-risk ranking run.

leading_anchor.description: The industry-specific first anchor or leading variable that can move profits before/with reported earnings.

earnings_confirmation.description: Latest structured profitability confirmation, normally from same-repo financial cross-section / level3 profitability state.

negative_evidence.description: Fresh falsifier / counter-evidence slot. An explicit checked_none record is valid; an absent slot is not.

status_semantics.complete: All required slots are present and fresh enough for the slot's own frequency.
status_semantics.partial: At least one useful slot exists, but one or more required slots are missing/stale.
status_semantics.missing: No usable current-cycle evidence is available.

strict_gate_rule: all 31 level1 industries must be complete before formal Decision Layer may rely exclusively on the evidence bundle
shadow_gate_rule: always emit diagnostics and never block existing production while machine adapters are still being built
